integrity: The homology computation is obtained from the published vanishing-cycle classes using the standard PALF handle complex. The Smith invariant factors are independently checked from exact integer minors. Mori's published calculation supplies the nonzero order-two property of \(c_1\).
scientific_limitations: The result concerns only the six-factor generalized-lantern PALF. It determines integral homology and the location of \(c_1\) in torsion, but not the fundamental group, intersection form, diffeomorphism type, or all fillings of the boundary.
title: The generalized-lantern filling has \(H_1\cong\mathbb Z/4\)
